name: bld2_involution_trace_eq_card
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (h : A * A = 1) (ht : Matrix.trace A = (Fintype.card ι : K)) : A = 1
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (h : A * A = 1) (ht : Matrix.trace A = (Fintype.card ι : K)), A = 1
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_involution_trace_rank and Mathlib2.bld_involution_rank_add_rank: the trace formula gives 2 * rank (1 + A) = 2 * card ι in K, hence (CharZero) rank (1 + A) = card ι; the rank identity then gives rank (1 - A) = 0, so 1 - A = 0.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), A * A = 1 → A.trace = ↑(Fintype.card ι) → A = 1
